errors.rate-limited: Too many questions at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: The chat is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.guardrails-blocked: The chat did not send this question: the conversation holds personal data that must not reach the model, such as a card number. Remove it from the question and ask again, or start a new conversation if an earlier answer holds it.
errors.failed: The chat could not answer this question.
errors.request: The question could not be sent.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Which model the chat uses, what it does when the provider fails, whether the model reasons before it answers, who can read personal data from it, and how its traces reach Phoenix.

model.title: Model
model.sentence: Every chat question goes to this LiteLLM alias; litellm/config.yaml maps it to a provider model.
model.notLoaded: The models could not be loaded.

sentences.off: Off: when the model's provider fails or is too slow, the question is retried, and if that fails too the answer ends with the error.
sentences.afterRetry: After a retry: when the model's provider fails or is too slow, LiteLLM retries it once, then sends the question to the fallback model that litellm/config.yaml names for the alias, if any.
sentences.atOnce: At once: when the model's provider fails or is too slow, LiteLLM sends the question to the fallback model that litellm/config.yaml names for the alias, if any, without a retry.

sentences.off: Off: the chat does not ask the model to reason before it answers.
sentences.medium: Medium: the chat asks the model to reason before it answers, with medium effort.
sentences.high: High: the chat asks the model to reason before it answers, with high effort. The answer takes longer and costs more tokens.

traces.title: App traces to Phoenix
traces.onMaskedSentence: On: the app also sends its own spans, masked by Presidio, and each question shows as one trace with its tool steps and LiteLLM's model calls.
traces.onUnmaskedSentence: On: the app also sends its own spans, unmasked while "Mask personal data in the app" is off, and each question shows as one trace with its tool steps and LiteLLM's model calls.
traces.offSentence: Off: only LiteLLM sends traces, one per model call, with the provider model and its cost but without the tool steps between calls.

join.title: Group LiteLLM calls per chat message
join.onSentence: On: LiteLLM's calls for one chat message share one trace even while app traces are off. The app's spans never arrive then, so Phoenix lists each call as a row of its own within that trace.
join.offSentence: Off: while app traces are off, each LiteLLM call is a trace of its own.
join.lockedSentence: App traces already group each question into one trace, so this applies again only while they are off.

llmSpans.title: App LLM traces to Phoenix
llmSpans.onSentence: On: the app's span of a model call is an LLM span with the call's tokens, so a question's trace counts each call's tokens twice, beside LiteLLM's span.
llmSpans.offSentence: Off: the app's span of a model call is a plain step, so each call's tokens and cost are counted once, on LiteLLM's span.
llmSpans.lockedSentence: The app sends no spans while app traces are off, so this applies only while they are on.

presidio.title: Mask personal data in the app
presidio.onSentence: On: the app replaces the people it knows with placeholders such as <PERSON_1> before the model reads them, and masks its own spans before they leave. E-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and PESELs are LiteLLM's guardrail's, on or off.
presidio.offSentence: Off: names and other personal data reach the model provider as written, and Phoenix shows them in LiteLLM's traces. Only LiteLLM's guardrail masks e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and PESELs and refuses a card number, and the app's own spans leave unmasked too while app traces are on.

appToPresidio.sent: The texts of the app's spans, while app traces are on, to mask the personal data in them. Questions and tool results are not sent.

appToLitellm.placeholders: The people the app knows as placeholders such as <PERSON_1>, everything else as the customers wrote it.
appToLitellm.asWritten: Names and other personal data included, as the customers wrote them.

appToPhoenix.masked: The app's spans, with personal data replaced by its type, such as <PERSON>.
appToPhoenix.asWritten: The app's spans, personal data included.

litellmToPresidio.sent: Every request, before it goes to the provider: LiteLLM's guardrail.

litellmToProvider.placeholders: The people as placeholders. The guardrail masks e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and PESELs, and a card number refuses the request.
litellmToProvider.placeholdersOrFallback: The people as placeholders. The guardrail masks e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and PESELs, and a card number refuses the request. When the model's provider fails, the same request goes to the fallback model's provider.
litellmToProvider.namesAsWritten: Names as written. The guardrail masks e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and PESELs, and a card number refuses the request.
litellmToProvider.namesAsWrittenOrFallback: Names as written. The guardrail masks e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and PESELs, and a card number refuses the request. When the model's provider fails, the same request goes to the fallback model's provider.

litellmToPhoenix.sent: Each model call, as the provider received it.

shapes.perQuestionWithSteps: One trace per question: the app's tool steps with LiteLLM's model calls.
shapes.perQuestionModelCalls: One trace per question, holding LiteLLM's model calls only.
shapes.perModelCall: One trace per model call, from LiteLLM only.
